description: Department of Forest Conservation - Conserved Forests Regulations No. 03 of 2021, published in the Gaz. Ex. No. 2252/29 dated 03.11.2021 are hereby rescinded with immediate effect. - Conserved Forest Regulations No. 02 of 2021 published in the Gaz. Ex. No..2250/40, 22.10.2021
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the rescission of specific forest conservation regulations (The Forest Conservation (Conserved Forests) Regulations No. 03 of 2021 and The Forest Conservation (Reserved Forests) Regulations No. 02 of 2021) under the Forest Conservation Ordinance. While it mentions a State Minister's name and title, it does not describe his detailed portfolio responsibilities or make any personnel changes. The core content is about modifying the legal/regulatory framework for forest conservation, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
